changes_vs_current: Eggs 3 to 1, Cereal 11 to 2, Bacon 2 to 3; Toast and Fruit added (4-5); Pancakes 1 to 6, Omelette 9 to 7, French Toast 5 to 8, Waffles 4 to 9; Grits and Shakshuka dropped; Eggs Benedict, Chicken and Waffles, Croissant, Cinnamon Roll (21-24) have no evidence and keep current order.
confidence: low-medium. 5 sources but different granularity: Eggs/Cereal/Toast/Fruit are broad categories in 3 polls, while Ranker and Grubhub rank dishes. Ranks 1-10 are reasonably supported (each has 1-4 sources); ranks 11-20 are mostly penalty artifacts from items missing in short lists. Ranker is a second-hand fan vote and drives French Toast/Waffles/Hash Browns; Pancakes at 6 and Waffles at 9 may be understated since Pancakes/Waffles/French Toast are the 'favorite' picks in several other polls (Challenge Butter 2024: pancakes/waffles 65% weekend pick, found via search snippet only, not read, so not used). YouGov Ratings Q2 2026 has Hash browns 84% and Eggs and bacon 83% in the American-dishes top 20 (read) but no breakfast-wide ranking; not aggregated.
